title: Thymoquinone Lipid Nanoparticles Cut the Gordian Knots of Depression via Neuroprotective BDNF and Downregulation of Neuro-inflammatory NF-kappaB, IL-6, and TNF-alpha in LPS Treated Rats.
authors: Alam, Mahtab; Javed, Md Noushad; Najmi, Abul Kalam; Ahmad, Farhan Jalees; Imam, Syed Sarim; Akhtar, Mohd
one_liner_zh: 该文研究胸腺醌脂质纳米颗粒的抗抑郁作用机制，涉及NF-kB等蛋白靶点的分子对接，但核心是药物递送与神经炎症通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: In over 300 million clinical cases, antidepressant drugs seem to provide only symptomatic relief and limited protection in life-threatening depressive events. OBJECTIVES: To compare neuronal-signaling mechanism and neuroprotective roles of Thymoquinone (TQ) suspension and its SLN (TQSLN) against standard antidepressant drug fluoxetine. METHODS: This research investigated in-silico docking at NF-KB p50 active site, CLSM based gut permeation, screening of antidepressant activities and neurosignaling pathways involved. RESULTS: As compared to fluoxetine, TQ reporteda significantly better docking score (-6.83 v/s -6.22) and a better lower free binding energy of (-34.715 Kcal/mol v/s -28.537 Kcal/mol). While poorly oral bioavailable and P-gp substrate TQ reported approximately 250% higher gut permeation if delivered as TQSLN formulation. In locomotor studies, as compared to TQS, TQSLN favored more prominent (p< 0.010) elevation in average time, horizontalactivity, average-velocity, and total-movement with reduced rest time LPS treated groups. However, in the tail suspension test, TQSLN significantly reduced immobility time (p<0.010). Similarly, In the modified force swimming test, TQSLN also significantly reduced immobility time (p<0.010), but swimming time (p<0.010) and climbing time (p<0.050) were significantly elevated. Subsequently, TQSLN reported significantly elevated neuroprotective BDNF (p<0.010) as well as hippocampal 5HT/TRP; accompanied with reduced levels of hippocampal inflammatory markers TNF-alpha (p<0.001) and IL-6 (p<0.010) as well as lower kynurenine and tryptophan ratio (KYN/TRP). Similarly, the hippocampal CA1 region further revealed TQSL more predominantly attenuated NF-kB nuclear translocation in the brain. CONCLUSION: Despite the poor bioavailability of TQ, TQSLN potentially attenuates neuroinflammatory transmitters and favors BDNF to modulate depressive neurobehavioral states.
abstract_zh: 背景：在超过3亿的临床病例中，抗抑郁药物似乎仅提供症状缓解，并在危及生命的抑郁事件中提供有限的保护。目的：比较百里醌（TQ）混悬液及其固体脂质纳米粒（TQSLN）与标准抗抑郁药物氟西汀在神经元信号传导机制和神经保护作用方面的差异。方法：本研究探讨了NF-KB p50活性位点的计算机模拟对接、基于共聚焦激光扫描显微镜（CLSM）的肠道渗透性、抗抑郁活性筛选及涉及的神经信号通路。结果：与氟西汀相比，TQ报告了显著更好的对接分数（-6.83对比-6.22）和更低的自由结合能（-34.715 Kcal/mol对比-28.537 Kcal/mol）。而口服生物利用度低且为P-糖蛋白底物的TQ，在作为TQSLN制剂递送时，肠道渗透性提高了约250%。在运动行为研究中，与TQS相比，TQSLN在LPS处理组中更显著（p<0.010）地增加了平均时间、水平活动、平均速度和总运动量，并减少了休息时间。然而，在悬尾试验中，TQSLN显著减少了不动时间（p<0.010）。同样，在改良强迫游泳试验中，TQSLN也显著减少了不动时间（p<0.010），但游泳时间（p<0.010）和攀爬时间（p<0.050）显著增加。随后，TQSLN报告了显著升高的神经保护性BDNF（p<0.010）和海马5HT/TRP；同时伴有海马炎症标志物TNF-α（p<0.001）和IL-6（p<0.010）水平降低，以及犬尿氨酸与色氨酸比值（KYN/TRP）降低。同样，海马CA1区域进一步显示TQSL更显著地减弱了脑内NF-kB核转位。结论：尽管TQ的生物利用度较差，但TQSLN可能通过减弱神经炎症递质并促进BDNF来调节抑郁性神经行为状态。
